items.title: Reducing Memory Overhead in Valkey 9.1
items.summary: The Valkey project says its latest release trims per-key memory overhead for strings and sorted sets, so a cache may fit more data and hit more often.
items.evidence: your cache may achieve a higher hit rate without requiring any changes

items.title: Manage caches with precision using Amazon CloudFront Invalidation by Cache Tag
items.summary: Amazon Web Services describes invalidating CloudFront objects by cache tag so related content can be purged together, and reports that invalidations take effect in under 5 seconds at P95.
items.evidence: invalidations take effect in under 5 seconds at P95
